declaration_reviews.complete_written_type:
theorem exists_deletedProduct_le (a : ι → ℕ) {n D : ℕ}

declaration_reviews.name: eraseAt_injective_of_product
card_le_sum_smallCovers
declaration_reviews.complete_written_type:
theorem card_le_sum_smallCovers (S : Finset (ι → ℕ)) {n D : ℕ}
    (hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card ι) (hprod : ∀ a ∈ S, (∏ j, a j) = n)
    (hcut : n ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) ≤ D ^ Fintype.card ι) :
    S.card ≤ ∑ i : ι, (S.filter (fun a => deletedProduct a i ≤ D)).card := by

declaration_reviews.name: card_le_sum_deletionFibers
declaration_reviews.complete_written_type:
theorem card_le_sum_deletionFibers (S : Finset (ι → ℕ)) {n D : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card ι)
    (hprod : ∀ a ∈ S, (∏ j, a j) = n)
    (hcut : n ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) ≤ D ^ Fintype.card ι) :
    S.card ≤ ∑ i : ι, ∑ d ∈ truncatedDivisors n D, (deletionFiber S i d).card := by

declaration_reviews.name: card_orderedFactorTuples_truncated
declaration_reviews.complete_written_type:
theorem card_orderedFactorTuples_truncated {K n D : ℕ}
    (hK : 2 ≤ K) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hcut : n ^ (K - 1) ≤ D ^ K) :
    (orderedFactorTuples K n).card ≤
      ∑ i : Fin K, ∑ d ∈ truncatedDivisors n D,
        (deletionFiber (orderedFactorTuples K n) i d).card := by

mathematical_review.deletedProduct_mul_and_dvd: The erase product multiplication identity matches prod_erase_mul. The divisibility witness is a_i with the required equality orientation; no positivity is needed for these two facts.
mathematical_review.cutoff: For K=card(iota)>=2 the index set is nonempty. At a maximum coordinate, prod_{j!=i} a_j <= a_i^(K-1). Multiplying this inequality by d^(K-1) and using K=(K-1)+1 yields d^K <= (d*a_i)^(K-1)=n^(K-1)<=D^K. The nonzero exponent K permits order reflection. All are natural-number inequalities, including zero factors.
mathematical_review.positivity_and_cancellation: The injectivity declaration retains hn:0<n. The product identity forces d!=0. Equality of updated functions gives equality at every j!=i, hence equality of deletion products; mul_left_cancel₀ then recovers coordinate i. No cancellation at n=0 is claimed.
mathematical_review.cover_and_union_cardinality: Small-deletion filters cover S. card_le_card followed by card_biUnion_le yields the indexed sum; ties contribute to multiple cover sets and are harmless in an upper bound.
mathematical_review.divisor_partition: For a member of the small cover, deletedProduct divides n and hn supplies n!=0 for Nat.mem_divisors. card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise partitions the small cover over n.divisors.filter(d<=D). The displayed hfiber equality removes the redundant cutoff by d<=D.
mathematical_review.deletion_images: At fixed positive n and fixed coordinate i, the update-to-1 map is injective on the product fiber; card_image_of_injOn therefore preserves each fiber cardinality. Coordinates remain indexed and repeated factor values do not merge ordered tuples. No unexplained embedding or quotient is used.
mathematical_review.explicit_tuple_carrier: Fintype.piFinset of n.divisors filtered by product=n is finite. For n>0 every coordinate of a positive factorization divides n, so this is the intended full ordered carrier mathematically; the present specialization only needs the displayed product filter, not an unproved cardinal identity.
edge_cases: K=0 and K=1 are excluded by hcard/hK; the geometric proof uses K>0 and K=(K-1)+1 only after hcard. No empty-index witness is inferred.

For n=0 the standalone geometric cutoff and cover remain true for K>=2, including tuples with zero coordinates. Those declarations deliberately omit hn. Positive n is restored before divisors and cancellation.
For K>=2,n>0,D=0 the cutoff hypothesis is impossible. S=empty is harmless for all finite cardinal inequalities.
For n=1 and admissible cutoff, all factors are 1 and the indexed cover can overlap K times; no tie-breaking is required.
At k=0 the explicit carrier has one empty tuple exactly when n=1. This observation is not installed as the missing native tau bridge.
